(
    cds         TEXT not null
        primary key,
    rtype       TEXT  not null,
    sname       TEXT null,
    dname       TEXT null,
    cname       TEXT null,
    enroll12    INTEGER         not null,

    AvgScrWrite INTEGER          null,

    foreign key (cds) references schools (CDSCode)
